name: Sapa
blurb: Sapa has appeared in travel conversation only in the last few weeks, from a base of almost nothing. Early posts are enthusiastic but the sample is still small.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find
Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Second time here and it still feels underrated.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
